ana_s: Quick sync — FinServe asked for an EU-only POC (2w). They want: signed subprocessors list, a routing assertion for auditors, BYO-KMS option, and a basic cost comparison hosted vs dedicated. Pinged presales.
mike_p: Quick clarifying q's: which model family are they testing? sustained RPS vs spikes? BYO-KMS required for POC or just for prod? Any specific compliance docs they asked for?
ana_s: They said redwood-gpt-medium for the test. Expect ~25 RPS sustained, spikes to ~90 for batch imports. BYO-KMS required for production but optional during POC (they want it priced). Auditor wants a network path diagram proving no cross-border hops.
jamal_ops: We can do tenant pinning to EU regions. GA EU regions that support pinning + control plane isolation: eu-west-1 (Ireland), eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), eu-north-1 (Stockholm). Subprocessor list we typically disclose: AWS (EC2, S3), Cloudflare (edge), Sentry (errors), Datadog (metrics). I can export the inventory + links to SOC2/ISO27001.
jamal_ops: Engineering statement we can provide: "When tenant is pinned to an EU region and geofence is enabled, both control-plane signals and inference data paths are routed within selected EU region(s); no egress to non-EU regions will occur." Need Legal to sign attestation.
elaine_se: Pricing headliners for the quote: hosted (no commit) short POC estimate — model compute + egress premium: approx +€0.035/token egress overhead; Dedicated (reserved) — egress billed at cost + margin ~€0.009/token, requires minimum commit (we recommend 1-3 months for meaningful delta). BYO-KMS add-on: one-time setup €2,000 + per-token handling fee €0.012. I'll add a small table to the quote doc.
mike_p: Auditor asks for a simple network flow diagram and a signed attestation that says: client -> fincorp network -> redwood eu-west-1 (control+data) -> inference nodes -> storage, with no cross-border hops. Can we generate that plus a config sample to show how pinning is enforced?
jamal_ops: Yes. I'll produce a diagram and a sample config snippet we use for pinned tenants:
```json
{"tenant_id":"fincorp-poc","pin_region":"eu-west-1","geofence_enabled":true,"fallback":"none"}
```
ana_s: Who will own getting Legal to sign the subprocessor attestation?
mike_p: I'll take point on the attestation and loop Legal. Elaine, please finish the POC quote with the BYO-KMS line items today so Legal has numbers for liability assessment.
elaine_se: On it. I'll upload the quote draft to the deal folder and highlight the delta rows. Also flag SLA differences: hosted has no uptime SLA; Dedicated has SLA + credits.
autoscale-bot: deployment note: finserve-poc-config v2 uploaded to staging at 2024-03-12T09:12Z
jamal_ops: Action list: (1) jamal_ops -> attach subproc inventory + SOC/ISO links; (2) mike_p -> legal attestation kickoff; (3) elaine_se -> updated POC quote with BYO-KMS + hosted vs dedicated comparison; (4) ana_s -> schedule kickoff + customer sync once attestation draft exists. ETA: 48h.
mike_p: ACK — looping Legal now and will post timeline. :thumbsup:
ana_s: Thanks — will hold customer call until we have the signed draft.
